display.title: Episode 498: At Home It Is Totally Different
display.summary_short: Early Cheshvan 5752: Reb Chaim visits the Maggid of Mezritch's bare cabin and learns that 'at home it is totally different'; plus a family visit to Studio 604 for the Shema.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi asks where Hashem's presence is found, answers 'where there is simchah', and reminds listeners that being Jewish, with Hashem's Torah, is reason enough to be happy, leading into the Hakochainik march. A ten-year-old boy who wrote in the week before leads the Shema, joined by his siblings and mother, and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time: the Baal Shem Tov sends his chassid Reb Chaim to deliver a sealed letter to his student Rabbi Dov Ber, later the Maggid of Mezritch. Reb Chaim is surprised to find the tzaddik in the shabbiest cabin in town, with logs for chairs and a plank that serves as table and, at night, bed. 'At home it is totally different,' the Maggid explains: this world is only a temporary lodging, and his real home is in Gan Eden, which he furnishes with Torah and mitzvos. Uncle Yossi urges children to do their shopping now, while they are in this world. He then describes the great victory parade out of golus that Tzivos Hashem children will lead, asks listeners to sign up their friends, invites letters and questions for the mailbox, and gives candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: This world is a temporary home; put your effort into 'furnishing' your eternal home with Torah and mitzvos.
